name: 租入会计 (UPA) (6EB)
description_en_html:
Overview

Lease contracts describe contractual agreements between two partners: the lessor and the lessee. The lessor is the owner of an asset, but the lessee has a right to use this asset during the period agreed in the lease contract. For the use of the asset, the lessee must pay lease payments that are agreed upon in the lease contract.

This scope item helps you standardize and automate your lease-in credit contract management activities for real estate, as well as for machinery, equipment, vehicles, computer hardware using the Universal Parallel Accounting Ledger.

You can easily create new contracts, execute periodic postings for existing contracts, and execute valuation postings for existing contracts.

You can change the supplier of an existing contract, as well as run reports of your existing contracts as part of your daily business.

You can create reminder rules for every contract (for example, to check the contract conditions, the contract term, or the renewal options), saving you time and effort and freeing up capacity for more strategic tasks.

Key Process Flow

  • Create contract
  • Maintain contract
  • Make adjustments
  • Integrate SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition and C4RE
  • Edit valuation rule
  • Perform periodic posting contract
  • Post contract valuation
  • Change supplier
  • Report contract
  • End contract
  • Perform administration tasks

Business Benefits

  • Accelerate leasing processes
  • Standardize and automate your recurring lease administration activities
  • Gain full control and visibility of leases and critical dates
  • Monitor critical dates on your leases, such as lease notifications and renewals
  • Improve decision making
  • Help ensure compliance to the latest financial reporting standards, such as the new lease accounting standard IFRS 16
description_zh_html:
概览

租赁合同描述了出租人和承租人两个合作伙伴之间的合同协议。出租人是资产的所有者，但承租人有权在租赁合同约定的期间内使用此资产。对于资产的使用，承租人必须支付租赁合同中约定的租赁费。

此范围项目可帮助您使用通用并行会计分类账标准化和自动化不动产以及机械、设备、车辆、计算机硬件的租入贷方合同管理活动。

您可以轻松创建新合同、执行现有合同的定期过账以及执行现有合同的评估过账。

您可以更改现有合同的供应商，并在日常业务中运行现有合同的报告。

您可以为每个合同创建提醒规则（例如，检查合同条件、合同条款或续订选项），从而节省时间和工作量，并释放更多战略任务的能力。

关键流程流

  • 创建合同
  • 维护合同
  • 进行调整
  • 集成 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 和 C4RE
  • 编辑评估规则
  • 执行定期过账合同
  • 过账合同评估
  • 更改供应商
  • 报告合同
  • 结束合同
  • 执行管理任务

业务优势

  • 加速租赁流程
  • 标准化和自动化周期性租赁管理活动
  • 获得租赁和关键日期的完全控制和可见性。
  • 监控租赁的关键日期，例如租赁通知和续订
  • 改进决策制定
  • 确保符合最新财务报告标准，如新租赁会计标准 IFRS 16
